title: A flat morphism locally of finite presentation of algebraic spaces is universally open

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a flat morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S which is locally of finite presentation is universally open (source lines 6095-6098). The proof lifts the morphism to a diagram of schemes with surjective etale vertical arrows, uses the locality of flatness and of local finite presentation to see that the induced morphism alpha : U -> V is flat and locally of finite presentation, applies the scheme case of the fppf openness theorem to alpha, and then transfers universal openness back to X -> Y by the local criterion.
